_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Template Store roadmap rendered at /extensions/template-library/roadmap. Template Library task status is maintained by `node scripts/gen-roadmap.mjs src/data/template-store-roadmap.json` from the extension source tree; store and content tasks have no code footprint in the plugin, so they are pinned and updated by hand.

milestones.title: Phase 1 · Decide
milestones.goal: Settle the product before building: what is sold, for how much, and where.

tasks.title: Sell templates, not prompts
tasks.detail: Unyson+ stays free; paid access to a growing library of landing page templates and sections, installed from wp-admin and made your own by hand or with the AI Assistant.

tasks.title: Plans and prices
tasks.detail: Free (3 templates + free sections), Pro (yearly, 1-3 sites), Agency (yearly, many sites, team seats), maybe Lifetime. Prices, sites per key, refunds and the payment provider to confirm.

tasks.title: Name and address
tasks.detail: The store at build.unysonplus.com; the product name and where live previews are hosted to confirm.

milestones.title: Phase 2 · Premium templates in the Template Library
milestones.goal: Pro templates appear locked in every Unyson+ site's Template Library and install with one click once a license key is entered.

tasks.title: Catalog tiers and versions
tasks.detail: Catalog entries gain tier (free / pro), version, preview link, screenshots and the Unyson+ version they need. The free catalog stays public.

tasks.title: License key
tasks.detail: Unyson+ → Template Library → License key: checked against the store, showing the plan, expiry and sites used.

tasks.title: Locked Pro templates
tasks.detail: Pro templates listed with a lock, their preview and a Get Pro link until a valid key is saved.

tasks.title: Premium install
tasks.detail: A Pro template downloads from the store with the key and the site address through a short-lived signed link, then installs like any template (photos into the Media Library).

tasks.title: Use this template's look
tasks.detail: An optional step that applies the template's colours, fonts and button / box presets to the whole site, with undo.

tasks.title: Template updates
tasks.detail: Update available for an installed template whose version changed; a page the buyer edited is never overwritten (the update arrives as a new copy).

milestones.title: Phase 3 · The store at build.unysonplus.com
milestones.goal: A storefront built on Unyson+ and its Membership extension: browse, preview, buy, get a key.

tasks.title: Template catalog and live previews
tasks.detail: A template post type with filters (business type, style, sections, free / Pro), a page per template with screenshots and a live desktop / phone preview.

tasks.title: Plans and checkout
tasks.detail: Membership plans with PayPal / Stripe, coupons, tax and invoices; team seats for the Agency plan.

tasks.title: License keys and the licenses API
tasks.detail: A key per membership (stored hashed), sites per key, revoked on refund; check and signed-download endpoints with rate limits.

tasks.title: Store pages
tasks.detail: Home, Templates, Sections, Pricing, Account (key, sites, invoices), Help, terms, refunds and privacy.

milestones.title: Phase 4 · The first collection
milestones.goal: Twelve original landing pages with their sections: three free, nine Pro.

tasks.title: Template pipeline
tasks.detail: Brief, original design, build with built-in elements and presets only, responsive / accessibility / speed checks, licensed photos with alt text, five AI-edit tests, screenshots, preview, package.

tasks.title: Three free templates
tasks.detail: Café / restaurant, freelancer portfolio and SaaS launch, in every Unyson+ site's Template Library.

tasks.title: Nine Pro templates
tasks.detail: Agency, coach, real estate, fitness studio, clinic, event, online course, home services and product launch, using Bookings, Membership, Forms and Kinetic Scenes where they fit.

milestones.title: Phase 5 · Launch and grow
milestones.goal: Bring Unyson+ users to the store and keep the library growing.

tasks.title: Launch
tasks.detail: A launch offer, reels and Shorts (WordPress first, Unyson+ at the end), links from unysonplus.com and the docs.

tasks.title: Two to four new templates a month
tasks.detail: New templates and sections each month; members vote on what comes next.
